issues.description: _shutdown_telemetry removes ALL LoggingHandlers from root, not just the OTLP one tied to this provider
issues.detail: The loop in traces.py iterates root handlers and removes any opentelemetry LoggingHandler instance. In a process hosting multiple providers or user-added LoggingHandlers (custom OTLP setups), unrelated handlers will be detached silently. Scope removal to handlers bound to this specific logger_provider.

issues.description: Buffered log records are replayed without filtering, potentially leaking pre-job logs into the job's OTLP stream
issues.detail: _start_log_buffering attaches the handler in _run_job_task before any job-specific filter is guaranteed to scope records. _BufferingHandler.emit captures every root log record regardless of source. On replay through OTLP, unrelated records from other concurrent jobs or the worker could be tagged to this job context.

issues.description: Unbounded in-memory log buffer can grow large for long-running pre-connect phases
issues.detail: _BufferingHandler.buffer is an unbounded list. If a job hangs before connect() for an extended period while logs are emitted at high volume, memory grows without limit. Consider a maxlen deque or a size cap with a warning when truncated.

issues.description: Removing -n auto and test_plugin_google_stt.py from unit-tests silently slows CI and drops coverage without justification
issues.detail: The makefile change drops pytest-xdist parallelism and removes the google STT test from the unit suite. Neither is explained in the PR description focused on log upload. If intentional, document why; otherwise this looks like leftover debugging.

The bare except Exception around init_recording during cleanup will hide configuration or import errors behind a single logger.exception. Consider narrower handling so genuine bugs (e.g., missing OTEL config) surface clearly during shutdown rather than being conflated with expected crash-path conditions.

issues.description: _pending_assignments registration moved after queue_msg send was reversed but no test covers the race
issues.detail: worker.py reorders pending_assignments registration to happen before _queue_msg, fixing a real race where the server assignment could arrive before the future is registered. Good fix, but there is no regression test. Worth adding a unit-level check that the assignment future is registered prior to the network send.

review.summary: The PR adds early log buffering to capture pre-connect crash logs and upload them via OTLP, plus a fix to a worker race and telemetry shutdown deadlock. The core approach is sound, but the OTLP handler removal in _shutdown_telemetry is too broad, the log buffer is unbounded, and replay may include records outside the job's intended scope. The makefile change (removing -n auto and a test) is unexplained and likely unintended. No new tests cover the crash-log path or the worker assignment race.
